newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Scania shares fall 3 pct on output cuts.
newsitem.headline: Scania shares fall 3 pct on output cuts.

text.p: Swedish truck maker Scania on Tuesday morning fell three percent on the Stockholm bourse after announcing late on Monday that its production in the first quarter of 1997 would be reduced.
At 0910 GMT the stock was five crowns lower at 163 crowns.

Scania on Monday said its production rate in Europe would be about 15 percent lower in the first quarter of 1997 from a year ago in order to balance delivery delays caused by the French truckers' strike in November.
It said this could also adversely impact fourth quarter 1996, hitting sales and earnings.
